title: torilis homoeophylla
intro: Torilis homoeophylla, commonly known as the wild chervil or lesser hemlock, is a plant species in the Apiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Torilis homoeophylla include its use as an antiseptic, anti-rheumatic, and antispasmodic agent, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
